home.amuni_text:
Welcome, o traveler, to the edge of time,
where history breathes in every gust of wind.
Hear the call of ancient and severe stones,
guardians of tales, of ladies, of ancient prayers.

Do not halt your step, mirror yourself in this magic,
Amunì, come, I show you the way.
home.castellana_intro_text: Talk to the Castellana: your multilingual tourist guide to discover unique stories, untold secrets, and culinary journeys among the wonders of the village and the surrounding territory.

citizen.legends_desc: The oldest stories of the village, passed down from generation to generation.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, o travelers, to the mighty manor,
that scans the valley and history evermore.
Perched proudly on the mountain of living stone,
guardian of dreams, of glory and mysteries unknown.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that challenge all of time,
dynasties passed like wind in prose or rhyme.
From the fierce, adventurous Chiaramonte name,
every chamber tells of treaties, splendor, and fame.
castle.rhyme_3:
Look not for dates within the cold text page,
but watch the shadow dancing on the candle's stage.
The Castellana awaits you, along the stone-paved way,
to unveil Sister Felicia's secret hidden away.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Feel free to ask.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, dominant over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and battlements recount its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble halls were theatres of medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground dungeons still preserve the traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel fought for a lady's love.

monuments.church_notice: ⚠️ Note: Places of worship are active and dedicated to liturgical functions. For tourist visits, please respect the recommended hours and avoid times of internal celebration.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is one of the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and evocative interior halls that recall centuries of feudal history and knightly legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is world-famous for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A visual art masterpiece suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular functions, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years old or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century alongside the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the village's most important spiritual centers. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed John Liccio, Patron of Caccamo. Inside, visitors can admire beautiful marble altars and sacred artworks testifying to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece dominating the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginiano school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visit Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Embedded in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality felt within. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that draw visitors and faithful alike.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sunday and Holidays visit slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply tied to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. Beyond the conventual building, the area offers an authentic insight into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to no less than 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other small scattered masterpieces.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith and memory,
open their doors to a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli rests, in the most sacred peace,
Blessed John, whose village blessings never cease.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you walk down to the Badia, the ground turns to bloom
in majolica ribbons that conquer all gloom.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the great Duomo, majestic and sublime,
among Gagini's marbles and Stom's art outside of time.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata reveals its painted skies,
and the bell tower guards where the old history lies.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Finally ascend to the Cappuccini on the radiant hill,
where an altarpiece shines and panoramas stand still.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has faded away...

transport_page.welcome: Welcome, o traveler, to the Transport section. Here you will find the necessary information to move around the surroundings of the village.
transport_page.company_desc: The bus lines connect Caccamo to Termini Imerese and Palermo all year round. By taking the afternoon route towards Palermo, it is possible to get off at Vetrana, a renowned seaside spot. From Termini Imerese, you can also take the train to Cefalù and other tourist destinations.
transport_page.stop_1: Porta Euracea: in front of Bar Giallombardo and the building materials store.
transport_page.stop_2: Viale Regione Siciliana: above the 'Roberta' playground (near the Axa insurance agency).
transport_page.stop_3: Piazza Cappuccini: under the shade of the ancient Convent.

events_page.title: Rituals and Festivals of the Village
events_page.intro: Experience the most authentic soul of our village through its centuries-old traditions, where faith, history, and folklore intertwine in unique and moving moments.
events_page.signuruzzu_desc: On Palm Sunday, a local child portrays Jesus and processes on a decorated donkey through the village streets, beautifully adorned with palms for the occasion. The procession stops in front of the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli and the Duomo of San Giorgio Martire for a solemn blessing.
events_page.venerdi_desc: The atmosphere deepens with the beautifully arranged altars in the churches for Good Friday, enriched with traditional sprouted wheat sprouts grown in the dark. This is followed by the solemn, deeply moving Procession and the town's Via Crucis.
events_page.giovanni_desc: A deeply felt celebration lived intensely by the entire community, which gathers around its Blessed Patron in an atmosphere of great devotion and popular warmth.
events_page.castellana_title: Election of the Castellana & Historical Parade
events_page.castellana_desc: The village dives back into its glorious medieval past. A majestic historical parade in period costumes winds through the streets, culminating in the solemn election of the Castellana of the castle.
events_page.nicasio_title: Feast of San Nicasio and the Palio
events_page.nicasio_desc: Vibrant celebrations in honor of the Saint, enriched by the highly anticipated and exciting town Palio, which sparks rivalry and enthusiasm among adults and children alike.
events_page.sagra_desc: Every year on October 12th, the aromas of tradition fill the village. An unmissable gastronomic event to taste the authentic local sausage amidst songs, wine, and warm conviviality.
